item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera's teacher asks the class: 'Earth supports life, while the Moon does not. What is the best explanation for this?' Which answer should Meera give?

options.A: Earth supports life only because it has water, so no other conditions matter.
options.B: Earth supports life because many linked conditions, such as air, water, soil, food and shelter, are present together near its surface.
options.C: Earth supports life only because it is the largest planet with a solid surface.
options.D: Earth supports life only because it receives sunlight from the Sun.
